title: Why the Best TV Ads Have a Big Cast and Fewer Speaking Roles
summary: Does casting affect ad performance? Research says more actors and fewer speaking roles drive stronger results.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


What the research suggests about who appears in your ad and who gets a line.


1. 1


In QuickFrame and MNTN’s study, 15- and 30-second ads with six or more actors had the highest visit and conversion rates.


2. 2


Ads performed best when about half the on-screen talent spoke, suggesting that a bigger cast doesn’t need more dialogue.


3. 3


Actor count may reflect production budget, so adding faces alone isn’t a proven way to improve performance.


4. 4


Female voices earned stronger trust ratings in the cited video and radio studies, though neither measured sales.


5. 5


Test casting and speaking roles against your own results, and try a voiceover swap as an inexpensive comparison.
